lesson.title: Rebase a Feature Branch and Resolve Conflicts
lesson.goal: rebase a feature branch onto main with git and resolve the conflicts

sources.title: Rebase a Feature Branch and Resolve Conflicts

steps.title: Clone and inspect the repository
steps.instructions: Clone the example repository, check out the feature/login branch, and inspect the history with git log --oneline --graph --all. Notice that main has two new commits ahead of where feature/login branched off.

precision_checks.label: On feature/login branch
precision_checks.command: cd git-rebase-example && git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD | grep -E 'feature/login'

targets.caption: Confirm you are on the feature/login branch before rebasing

explanations.topic: How rebasing replays commits onto a new base
Checking if commits are already pushed with git branch -a
Aborting a rebase with git rebase --abort
How git applies commits one by one during rebase

hints: Which branch do you need to be on before running git rebase main?
Clone https://github.com/philomatics/git-rebase-example.git and enter the cloned folder.
Run git checkout feature/login and git log --oneline --graph --all.
common_mistakes: Running commands while still on main instead of checking out feature/login.
Rebasing commits in a real project after they have already been pushed to a shared remote.
steps.run_command: git clone https://github.com/philomatics/git-rebase-example.git && cd git-rebase-example && git checkout feature/login && git log --oneline --graph --all

steps.title: Start rebasing onto main
steps.instructions: From feature/login run git rebase main, then git status to see that the rebase paused on a conflict in index.js.

targets.caption: Check Unmerged paths to see which file needs conflict resolution

explanations.topic: How conflict markers show current and incoming changes

hints: Ensure you are on feature/login and pass the target base branch to git rebase.
Run git rebase main to start replaying commits onto main.
Run git status to inspect the paused rebase and conflicted file.
common_mistakes: Passing the current branch name to git rebase instead of main.
Trying to run git commit when a rebase pauses on a conflict.

steps.title: Resolve conflicts in index.js
steps.instructions: Open index.js and remove all conflict markers while keeping code from both branches. Keep DEFAULT_USER set to admin and retain the /profile route, logging middleware, and /login route.

targets.caption: Keep "admin" and delete the conflict markers around DEFAULT_USER
Keep /profile, the logging middleware, and /login without conflict markers

hints: There are two conflicted sections: DEFAULT_USER near the top and the routes below.
Keep DEFAULT_USER = "admin" and keep both the /profile + middleware block and the /login block, then save.
common_mistakes: Leaving a conflict marker line behind in index.js.
Deleting the /profile route or request logging middleware from main.
Forgetting to save index.js before moving back to the terminal.
steps.code: const DEFAULT_USER = "admin"; ... app.get('/profile', (req, res) => { ... }); app.use((req, res, next) => { ... }); app.post('/login', (req, res) => { ... });

steps.title: Stage index.js and continue rebase
steps.instructions: Stage index.js with git add and run git rebase --continue, saving the commit message editor (:wq in Vim). Git applies the commit and stops at the next conflict in package.json.

precision_checks.label: index.js committed in rebase
precision_checks.command: cd git-rebase-example && git log --oneline -n 5 | grep -q 'Add login endpoint'

targets.caption: Continue the rebase after staging index.js

explanations.topic: Why rebase uses --continue instead of git commit
Saving and exiting Vim with Escape then :wq

hints: Stage your resolved file before continuing the rebase.
Run git add index.js followed by git rebase --continue.
When Vim opens for the commit message, press Escape, type :wq, and hit Enter.
common_mistakes: Running git rebase --continue without staging index.js first.
Running git commit instead of git rebase --continue.
Getting stuck in Vim or quitting without saving.

steps.title: Resolve package.json and finish rebase
steps.instructions: Remove the conflict markers in package.json while keeping "check": "node --check index.js", then git add package.json and git rebase --continue. Close the commit message editor and verify with git status.

precision_checks.label: Rebase complete
precision_checks.command: cd git-rebase-example && test ! -d .git/rebase-merge && test ! -d .git/rebase-apply && git merge-base --is-ancestor main HEAD

targets.caption: Keep the incoming check script and remove all conflict markers
Verify the rebase completed and git status is clean

explanations.topic: Verifying rebase completion with git status

hints: Open package.json and look for conflict markers inside "scripts".
Keep "check": "node --check index.js", save package.json, and run git add package.json.
Run git rebase --continue, save and exit the editor (:wq), then run git status.
common_mistakes: Leaving invalid JSON syntax or conflict markers in package.json.
Forgetting to run git rebase --continue after staging package.json.
steps.run_command: git add package.json && git rebase --continue && git status
